notes: Each 518a application requires its own ID and Proof of Address (<= 3 months).
Annexure A must be completed for EACH firearm included with the application.
Where 517g and 518a are submitted together, each app keeps its own complete document set.

declarations.heading: Convictions
declarations.text: I have not been convicted of any offence in terms of the Firearms Control Act, 2000 (Act No. 60 of 2000) and sentenced to a period of imprisonment without the option of a fine.

declarations.heading: Fit to possess
declarations.text: I have not been declared unfit to possess a firearm in terms of the Firearms Control Act, 2000 (Act No. 60 of 2000).

declarations.heading: Firearm safety
declarations.text: I will carry the firearm as prescribed in Section 98(5)(a) of the Firearms Control Act, 2000 (Act No. 60 of 2000) and regulation 78 of the Firearms Control Regulations 2004.

declarations.heading: Mounted safe
declarations.text: I have a safe that is properly mounted to a fixed structure and which complies with the requirements of SABS standard 953-1 and / or 953-2.

declarations.heading: Interpreter
declarations.text: I am not using an interpreter for this application.

declarations.heading: Nominee / Authorized person
declarations.text: The application is submitted by me (not by or for a nominee or authorized person).

declarations.heading: Literacy
declarations.text: I confirm that I can read and write English.

declarations.heading: GunCerts liability
declarations.text: I understand that GunCerts cannot guarantee that my application will be successful.

notes.title: Motivation
text: Some Designated Firearms Officers (DFOs) require motivations to accompany the 518(a) application.
We recommend that you check with your DFO to ensure you include all required documents for your application.

notes.title: Character references
text: Some Designated Firearms Officers (DFOs) require character references to accompany the 518(a) application.
We recommend that you check with your DFO to ensure you include all required documents for your application.
Ensure each character reference is signed by the person providing the statement. These should be dated and signed within the last 3 months.
Character references do not need to be certified.

notes.title: Document certification:
text: All copies of documents submitted must be certified as true copies of the original by a Commissioner of Oaths.
This can be done at a police station, post office, bank, or by a lawyer or notary public.

notes.title: Application submission date (Section D, questions 37 - 38, page 3):
text: SAPS prefers that you hand in your application at least 90 days before expiration date to allow them enough time to process your application before it expires.
There should only be one `YES` tick between questions 37, 38 and 39.
You only need to provide a reason if you tick `YES` for question 38 or 39.

notes.title: Disclaimer
text: It is your responsibility to ensure that all information and documents submitted are accurate, complete, and truthful.
GunCerts does not guarantee the success or approval of any application.

instructions.formInstructionTitle: Final steps for completing the SAPS 518(a) form:

text: Tick `YES` if you submitted your application at your SAPS station 90 days (or more) before expiry date.
If you tick `YES` here, then tick `NO` in questions 38 and 39. You don't need to provide a reason if you tick yes here.
Tick `NO` if you submitted your application less than 90 days before expiry date. Provide a reason why you didn't manage to submit the application 90 days before expiration in question 38 or 39.
Tick `YES` if you submitted your application less than 90 days before it expired, but before it expired. Provide a reason in the space provided.
If you tick `YES` here, then tick `NO` in questions 37 and 39.
Tick `YES` if you submitted your application after expiry and provide a reason in the space provided.
Tick `NO` if you submitted your renewal application before it expired.
This section will be completed in the presence of the police officer receiving your application.
Ensure you have passport photos as prescribed in the `Note:` section of this section.
This section will be completed in the presence of the police officer receiving your application.
